description: Halo encircling a multi-stone centre: eighteen stones on an origin-anchored 6.0mm ring around a toi-et-moi pair.
knownLimitations: HALO_METAL_ABSENT: a stone solid is built for every halo stone, but no metal is generated to hold them. A setting is built only for the primary stone; the halo stones are placed reference geometry.
